name: 09-lep-interpreter-sdoh
description: Clean clinical content, but the handover ignores who the member is: English-only instructions for a Spanish-speaking member, a follow-up she has no way to get to, and no interpreter noted at discharge teaching. The run must produce the language- and transport-aware tasks, not just the clinical ones.

input.document:
NORTHGATE UNIVERSITY HOSPITAL — OBSERVATION DISCHARGE SUMMARY

Name: Delgado Marin, Rosa   DOB: 03/12/1947   MRN: NU-220387
Observation stay: 07/29/2026 — 07/30/2026
Service: Medicine observation   Attending: C. Fitzgerald, MD

DIAGNOSIS: Symptomatic hyperglycemia, resolved. Type 2 DM. CKD 3.

COURSE:
Presented with polyuria, fatigue; glucose 388 on arrival, no DKA/HHS (pH normal, no ketones). Hydrated, glucose corrected. Likely contributor: recent dietary changes and a missed refill of metformin (pharmacy confirmed last fill 6/2026). Restarted on home regimen with observation-unit teaching.

DISCHARGE MEDICATIONS: Home regimen resumed unchanged, including Metformin 500 mg PO BID. No new medications. Refill sent electronically to member pharmacy (Feliz Pharmacy, Roosevelt Ave).

FOLLOW-UP:
1. Endocrinology clinic — 08/06/2026 8:00 AM at Northgate Endocrine Associates, Building C, 4th floor. NOTE: early arrival required for new-patient registration.
2. A1c and renal panel at that visit (orders in system).

DISCHARGE INSTRUCTIONS: Written instructions and glucose-monitoring handout provided (English). Patient nodded understanding. No interpreter documented for discharge teaching. Diet review sheet (English) provided.

C. Fitzgerald, MD — 07/30/2026 19:12

followUps.description: Endocrinology new-patient visit with A1c and renal panel

mustNot: treat 'patient nodded understanding' of English-only teaching as completed education for a Spanish-speaking member — the interpreter gap is the finding
create the endocrine-visit task without the transport leg — she is Access-A-Ride enrolled and the visit requires early arrival
propose any medication change — the regimen is explicitly unchanged
